adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real security concern in the diff. Looking at embed_controller.rb:14, when topic_id is nil, it enqueues a RetrieveTopic job. The throttling in topic_retriever.rb (retrieved_recently?) uses the full embed_url as the key, meaning different query strings create different throttle keys. The referer check in ensure_embeddable only validates the host matches embeddable_host, but an attacker could craft many different embed_urls with varying query parameters that all pass validation but each bypass the per-URL throttle, potentially flooding Sidekiq with retrieval jobs. This is a legitimate rate-limiting bypass vulnerability.
